name: DPDP Act 2023
description: India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 — obligations for Data Fiduciaries (DFs), rights of Data Principals (DPs), and penalties up to ₹250 crore per significant breach.

controls.name: Lawful processing
controls.req: Process personal data only for a lawful purpose (consent of the DP, or one of the specified legitimate uses in First Schedule).

controls.name: Consent notice
controls.req: Provide a clear, concise consent notice in the DP's language covering purpose, DP's rights and grievance redressal, before consent.

controls.name: Consent manager
controls.req: Where consent is sought for processing, use a Consent Manager (registered with DPB) — applicable for prescribed significant DFs.

controls.name: Purpose limitation
controls.req: Process personal data only for the purpose specified in the notice; non-consensual secondary uses prohibited.

controls.name: Data minimization
controls.req: Collect only the minimum personal data necessary for the specified purpose.

controls.name: Storage limitation
controls.req: Retain personal data only as long as needed for the purpose (deletion procedure + retention schedule enforceable).

controls.name: Accuracy and correction
controls.req: Take reasonable steps to ensure accuracy and completeness of personal data, considering the purpose of processing.

controls.name: Security safeguards
controls.req: Reasonable security safeguards to prevent personal data breach; breach includes loss, unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure.

controls.name: Breach notification
controls.req: Notify the Data Protection Board AND each affected DP of any personal data breach — in the form/manner prescribed, within the timeline prescribed.

controls.name: Grievance redressal
controls.req: Establish a mechanism (DP Grievance Officer, contact details in notice) to answer DP questions and resolve grievances.

controls.name: Children's data
controls.req: Process children's personal data only with verifiable parental consent and with safeguards; no tracking/behavioural ads on children.

controls.name: Data processor obligations
controls.req: Processors act under a contract with the DF covering purpose, security safeguards, and limitation of use.

controls.name: Significant Data Fiduciary duties
controls.req: If classified Significant DF (government notification): Data Protection Impact Assessment, audit annually (data processor too), and additional obligations.

controls.name: Right to access & summary
controls.req: Provide the DP a summary of personal data processed and the processing activities, on request.

controls.name: Right to correction & erasure
controls.req: Correct inaccurate data, complete incomplete data, and erase personal data (subject to lawful-retention exceptions).

controls.name: Right to grievance redressal
controls.req: Respond to DP grievances within the prescribed time period (currently 30 days in draft rules, extendable).

controls.name: Right to withdraw consent
controls.req: Provide an easy mechanism to withdraw consent; stop processing from withdrawal unless a legitimate-use exception applies.

controls.name: Right to nominate
controls.req: Allow the DP to nominate a person to exercise rights in case of death or incapacity.

categories.name: Breach handling, penalties, and compliance ops

controls.name: Incident response aligned to breach definition
controls.req: Treat loss, unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure or destruction as 'personal data breach' — IR plan must cover all five.

controls.name: Board notification timeliness
controls.req: Establish capability to notify Board within required timeline (rules pending; best practice: 72h).

controls.name: Affected DP notification content
controls.req: Prepare breach communication template: what happened, data affected, measures taken, and DP remedy steps.

controls.name: Penalty exposure tracking
controls.req: Track penalty bands (up to ₹250 crore per significant breach) in risk register; map control gaps to exposure.

controls.name: Registration/operations readiness
controls.req: Track DPB rule-making (2025 draft rules): DP Grievance Officer appointment, consent managers, and audit timelines.

categories.name: AI / ML system mapper (DPDP × AI lifecycle)

controls.name: Lawful basis for AI training data
controls.req: Document lawful purpose + consent/or legitimate use for every personal-data dataset used to train, fine-tune, or evaluate models.

controls.name: Consent notice for AI features
controls.req: Notice must disclose AI-based processing (e.g. behaviour analysis, recommendations) and allow refusal (especially for children's content).

controls.name: Data minimization in training
controls.req: Minimize training data — use synthetic/anonymized data where the purpose permits; no blanket scraping of DPs' data.

controls.name: Storage limitation for model artifacts
controls.req: Define retention for datasets, model checkpoints, and inferences; purge after purpose or on DP request.

controls.name: Accuracy obligations for automated decisions
controls.req: Automated decisioning (scoring, classification) must be accurate and complete per purpose — validate drift on protected classes.

controls.name: Security safeguards for model IP + data
controls.req: Protect training pipelines, model weights and inference data (MFA, encryption, prompt-leak controls) as personal data security safeguards.

controls.name: Breach = training-data exposure
controls.req: Model inversion/leakage of personal data counts as personal data breach — include in breach-notification scope.

controls.name: Grievance redressal for AI outputs
controls.req: DPs may question processing decisions driven by AI — maintain explainability records and a human-accessible appeal path.

controls.name: Children's AI services
controls.req: AI features for children require verifiable parental consent + safeguards; prohibit behavioural tracking/ad targeting on children.

controls.name: Significant DF + AI DPIA
controls.req: If Significant DF: DPIA for high-risk AI processing (profiling, biometrics, large-scale) before deployment; audit annually.

source: Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 (India) + 2025 draft rules
license: Public statute — simplified mapper (legal advice required for compliance)
